messages:
sam_partnerships: Quick preflight: aim to get AWS/GCP/Azure listings into sandbox today. Need owners for publisher IDs, tax forms, images/artifacts, legal sign-off, and marketing blurbs. Short checklist so QA can validate.

julia_cp: I'll take publisher IDs + listing copy. Need logos (svg/png) and one-line tagline.

anika_security: I'll own security contacts and image hardening. Also request SOC attestation before public publish.

mike_cloudops: I'll handle artifacts: container + AMI + Azure VHD + GCP image. Need allowed regions and test license tokens.

marketplace-bot: Sandbox IDs created: aws_sbx_1840, gcp_sbx_1840, az_sbx_1840. Checklist entry: metadata.support_contact missing.

julia_cp: Adding support@redwood.ai and marketing screenshots. Draft short: "Redwood Inference — predictable, scalable LLM inference."

anika_security: Change wording: use "metered billing" not "pay-as-you-go". Confirmed /meter endpoint will redact prompt text.

mike_cloudops: E2E plan: publish sandbox offer -> bootstrap with license -> call /meter -> validate billing record. Will run in 2 hours.

sam_partnerships: Finance, please confirm timing for W-9/W-8 submission. Need forms before revenue acceptance.

marketplace-bot: Validation results (sandbox): container scan: 2 low findings; AMI build: ok; metadata: missing escalation contact.

anika_security: Added incident@redwood.ai and PGP fingerprint to metadata.

julia_cp: Marketing approves copy/screenshots. Legal to review publisher agreement for Azure separately.

mike_cloudops: E2E sandbox pass. Billing stub recorded for test offer. No blockers.

sam_partnerships: Great. I'll update checklist and schedule final publish slot. Follow-up thread for launch window. :rocket:
